{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()

# Print only the required number, without additional commentary
print(mean_age)"}
